temporal_state_chain.observed: At the funeral, Sara notices Shirley's somber demeanor and hears Shirley say the loss has been tough, that she keeps wondering if more could have been done, and that it is hard to let go.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believed Shirley cared for the patient and might be grieving, but she did not yet know how deeply Shirley was affected or whether Shirley felt any self-doubt.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Sara's suspicion is confirmed, and she learns Shirley is deeply affected and is second-guessing whether more could have been done.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley is deeply grieving the patient's death, struggling to let go, and possibly carrying doubt or responsibility about the care provided.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Compassion, concern, and sadness for Shirley.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To console and reassure Shirley, remind her of the good care they provided, and help her begin processing the loss.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During a coffee break, Sara hears Shirley explicitly say she feels responsible and wonders whether pushing for a different treatment approach might have changed the outcome.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: From the funeral, Sara believed Shirley was deeply affected and possibly second-guessing the care, but she was not certain Shirley felt personally responsible.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Sara learns Shirley carries an explicit sense of responsibility and guilt about the treatment outcome.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley feels burdened by responsibility and is struggling to accept that their decisions were the best they could make with the information available.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Empathy, concern, and a desire to relieve Shirley's guilt.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To alleviate Shirley's sense of responsibility by reassuring her that the team made the best decisions possible and that she should not carry the burden alone.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara observes Shirley's continued reserved behavior and minimal emotional expression, and hears Shirley admit she holds back feelings because she does not want to seem unprofessional or weak.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believed Shirley was grieving and felt responsible or burdened, and she had noticed Shirley being reserved, but she did not know Shirley was deliberately suppressing emotions out of fear of appearing weak.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Sara learns Shirley is holding back her feelings because she fears being seen as unprofessional or weak.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley needs encouragement and a safe, friendly space to express her emotions, and that Shirley may be trying to appear strong at the cost of opening up.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concern, empathy, and gentle worry for Shirley's emotional well-being.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To encourage Shirley to express her feelings openly and reassure her that showing emotion is healthy and not a sign of weakness.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara hears Shirley say the previous conversation was a bit much, but that she knows Sara meant well and appreciates the apology; Shirley also says she wants to keep talking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believed Shirley might be suppressing emotions and needed to open up, but she worried that her previous confrontation had been too harsh and may have strained their friendship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Sara learns Shirley felt her approach was a bit much but understood her good intentions, accepted the apology, and values continued conversation.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes their friendship and trust are intact, that Shirley appreciates her support, and that she should be supportive without pushing too hard.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Relief, regret or apology, and warmth toward Shirley.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To repair any strain from the previous conversation, remain available in whatever way Shirley needs, and keep communication open and gentle.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara notices Shirley seems to be doing better and hears Shirley say she is feeling better thanks to their talks and Sara's support; Shirley agrees to plan something for the weekend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believed Shirley was still working through grief and guilt but that their communication had improved and she might be getting better, though Sara was not certain how much progress Shirley had made.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Sara learns Shirley is improving, credits their talks and Sara's support, and is willing to spend more time together outside work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley is making positive progress, that her support is helping, and that a closer friendship outside work could further help Shirley.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue supporting Shirley and plan a weekend activity to nurture their friendship and Shirley's ongoing recovery.
